overview_description.description: Talon Dust Control provides dust control and soil stabilization solutions. Their products control surface dust lift-off when applied to open areas, material stockpiles and slopes, unpaved roads, heavy haulage roads, and parking. They develop Talon Dust Control to serve customers in the harsh desert settings of the Middle East and North Africa.
